Subject: Need help with a tenancy eviction case

Hello, my name is Divya Ahuja. I am a 58-year-old dentist living in Kolhapur. I have a tenancy problem with Fatima Sathe involving ₹8,80,000 in rent, and the landlord needs the premises for the family's own use. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 91544 93210 or email divya.ahuja@example.in.
